coverageLabel.zh: 国际象棋、围棋、扑克、狼人杀

researchUse.zh: 比较完全信息、不完全信息与社会推理场景中的逐步决策。
researchUse.en: Compare step-by-step decisions under perfect information, hidden information and social reasoning.

scope.zh: 平台持续评测模型；总榜与各游戏榜分别保留原始协议。
scope.en: Platform-run model evaluations; the unified board and game-specific boards retain their respective protocols.

scoring.zh: 总榜使用来源汇总口径；单项保留原站评级与置信区间，不与其他平台的 Elo 混排。
scoring.en: Use the source aggregation for the unified board and native ratings and intervals for each game; ratings are not pooled across platforms.

variation.zh: 保留来源的版本、赛道与模型配置。
variation.en: Retain the source version, track and model configuration.

verification.zh: 成绩由维护方发布；本站提供来源索引。
verification.en: Results are published by the maintainer; Atlas indexes the source.

dates.zh: 成绩日期取自来源；本站采集日期单独记录。
dates.en: Result dates come from the source; the Atlas retrieval date is recorded separately.

control.zh: 模型通过各游戏 harness 逐步行动。
control.en: Models act step by step through each game harness.

budget.zh: 输入、重试和回合预算按各单项协议查看。
budget.en: Inputs, retries and turn budgets are specified by each game protocol.

researchUse.zh: 研究从规则理解到策略代码生成的可靠性与对战能力。
researchUse.en: Study rule-to-code reliability and the competitive strength of generated policies.

scope.zh: 模型生成可执行玩家程序，由游戏引擎组织对战。
scope.en: Models generate executable player programs that compete through the game engine.

scoring.zh: B1（Bradley–Terry）转换为相对固定参考群体的 0–100 分。主分数计入生成失败的零分；可运行程序强度另列。
scoring.en: B1 (Bradley–Terry) yields a 0–100 score against a fixed reference field. The headline includes failed generation attempts as zero; working-program strength is separate.

variation.zh: 保留来源的版本、赛道与模型配置。
variation.en: Retain the source version, track and model configuration.

verification.zh: 成绩由维护方发布；本站提供来源索引。
verification.en: Results are published by the maintainer; Atlas indexes the source.

dates.zh: 成绩日期取自来源；本站采集日期单独记录。
dates.en: Result dates come from the source; the Atlas retrieval date is recorded separately.

control.zh: 模型写策略程序；对局时执行程序。
control.en: Models write policies; compiled programs play the games.

budget.zh: 按来源游戏 SDK、生成与修复预算评测；推理档位不表示跨厂商等量计算。
budget.en: Use the source SDK and generation/repair budgets; reasoning levels do not imply equal compute across providers.

coverageLabel.zh: 国际象棋 · LLM 对战

researchUse.zh: 比较逐步棋局规划、合法行动、推理成本和响应时间。
researchUse.en: Compare move planning, legal actions, reasoning cost and response time.

scope.zh: chessbench-v3 的 Best 视图，每个模型保留来源选出的推理配置。
scope.en: The chessbench-v3 Best view, retaining the thinking setup selected by the source for each model.

scoring.zh: 来源界面称 Elo Rating，方法为 Glicko-2。评级仅针对该 LLM 对战池；每种推理配置独立计分。
scoring.en: The UI labels ratings Elo Rating; the method is Glicko-2. Ratings apply to this LLM pool, with thinking setups rated separately.

variation.zh: 保留来源的版本、赛道与模型配置。
variation.en: Retain the source version, track and model configuration.

verification.zh: 完整收录原站 Best 表的 18 行；全部推理配置与逐局记录可在原站查看。
verification.en: All 18 rows of the source Best table are retained. All thinking setups and individual matches remain available at the source.

dates.zh: 成绩日期取自来源；本站采集日期单独记录。
dates.en: Result dates come from the source; the Atlas retrieval date is recorded separately.

control.zh: 模型接收棋盘、棋子、合法着法与历史，逐步选招；Stockfish 分析仅供观众查看。
control.en: Models receive the board, pieces, legal moves and history, then select moves. Stockfish analysis is viewer-only.

budget.zh: 按实际推理配置分组；成本为完整计价对局的美元均值，用时为每步模型请求时间。
budget.en: Group by thinking setup; cost is USD per fully priced completed game, and time is model request time per move.

snapshotLabel.zh: Best 视图 · 18 个模型配置

researchUse.zh: 研究限时策略开发、练习反馈利用和长期编码迭代。
researchUse.en: Study time-bounded policy development, practice feedback and long-horizon coding iteration.

scope.zh: 按版本发布评测，v0.2 使用各模型厂商的 CLI harness。
scope.en: Versioned evaluations; v0.2 uses each provider’s CLI harness.

scoring.zh: 每个模型 5 次独立开发，最终 Bot 对 13 个固定对手，在 3 张地图各交战 6 次；报告平均胜率。v0.1 的缩放 Elo 不与此分数混合。
scoring.en: Five development runs per model; each final bot faces 13 fixed opponents six times on each of three maps. Reported scores are mean win rates, separate from v0.1 scaled Elo.

variation.zh: 保留来源的版本、赛道与模型配置。
variation.en: Retain the source version, track and model configuration.

verification.zh: 成绩由维护方发布；本站提供来源索引。
verification.en: Results are published by the maintainer; Atlas indexes the source.

dates.zh: 成绩日期取自来源；本站采集日期单独记录。
dates.en: Result dates come from the source; the Atlas retrieval date is recorded separately.

control.zh: 生成 C++ Bot，BWAPI 4.4.0 / OpenBW；不是模型逐帧操作。
control.en: Generate C++ bots for BWAPI 4.4.0 / OpenBW, rather than frame-by-frame model control.

budget.zh: 每次开发 1 小时，可编译、练习、读日志；对局上限 60 分钟。
budget.en: One hour per development run, with compilation, practice and logs; match limit 60 minutes.

researchUse.zh: 比较长期策略开发、资源调度与完整 RTS Bot 的竞技表现。
researchUse.en: Compare sustained policy development, resource management and full RTS bot performance.

scope.zh: 2026 Season 2；完整 Bot 在所属分区循环对战。
scope.en: 2026 Season 2; full bots play round-robin matches within their division.

scoring.zh: 赛季 Melee ladder 使用 Elo，初始 1600、K=16；成绩按赛季与分区阅读。Micro ladder 为独立的非赛季协议。
scoring.en: The seasonal Melee ladder uses Elo with initial rating 1600 and K=16. Read scores within season and division; Micro is a separate non-seasonal protocol.

variation.zh: 保留来源的版本、赛道与模型配置。
variation.en: Retain the source version, track and model configuration.

verification.zh: 成绩由维护方发布；本站提供来源索引。
verification.en: Results are published by the maintainer; Atlas indexes the source.

dates.zh: 成绩日期取自来源；本站采集日期单独记录。
dates.en: Result dates come from the source; the Atlas retrieval date is recorded separately.

control.zh: 参赛者提交完整 Bot；模型厂商不等于 Bot 提交团队。
control.en: Participants submit complete bots; model vendors are distinct from bot authors.

budget.zh: 地图与 Bot 版本按赛季固定；新赛季需重新激活。
budget.en: Maps and bot versions follow the season; bots must be reactivated for a new season.

label.zh: 社区成绩视图 · AI Arena Recap

researchUse.zh: 研究规则发现、主动探索、状态建模与行动效率。
researchUse.en: Study rule discovery, active exploration, state modeling and action efficiency.

scope.zh: 2026 竞赛赛道；与官方 Verified 榜和 Developer Preview 分开。
scope.en: The 2026 competition track, separate from the Verified board and Developer Preview.

scoring.zh: 使用本届竞赛的官方评分与私有测试协议，保留公开榜 / 最终榜区分；不混入社区展示分数。
scoring.en: Use this competition’s official scoring and private evaluation protocol; public and final standings remain distinct from community showcase scores.

variation.zh: 保留来源的版本、赛道与模型配置。
variation.en: Retain the source version, track and model configuration.

verification.zh: 成绩由维护方发布；本站提供来源索引。
verification.en: Results are published by the maintainer; Atlas indexes the source.

dates.zh: 成绩日期取自来源；本站采集日期单独记录。
dates.en: Result dates come from the source; the Atlas retrieval date is recorded separately.

control.zh: 提交能够与新环境交互的 Agent，评测期间无网络访问。
control.en: Submit an agent that interacts with novel environments; evaluation has no internet access.

budget.zh: 本届提交截止 2026-11-02 (UTC)；计算与行动预算以竞赛规则为准。
budget.en: Submission deadline: 2026-11-02 (UTC). Compute and action budgets follow competition rules.

coverageLabel.zh: 5 个文字交互框架 · 含 ScienceWorld

researchUse.zh: 比较文字环境中的多步规划、任务执行与科学实验推理；ScienceWorld 可单独排序。
researchUse.en: Compare multi-step planning, task execution and scientific reasoning in text environments; rank ScienceWorld separately.

scope.zh: 同一 TALES 协议下的框架分项和总分，保留来源全部 40 个模型配置。
scope.en: Framework scores and overall scores under the TALES protocol, retaining all 40 source model configurations.

scoring.zh: 保留原站 TALES 总分及五个框架的百分比分数，不重新平均框架得分。ScienceWorld 分数仅代表 TALES 使用的任务与设置。
scoring.en: Retain the source TALES overall score and percentages for five frameworks without re-averaging them. ScienceWorld scores apply to the tasks and setup used by TALES.

variation.zh: 保留来源的版本、赛道与模型配置。
variation.en: Retain the source version, track and model configuration.

verification.zh: 来源为 TALES 官方网页的完整结果表；模型提供方不代表独立提交团队。
verification.en: Source: the full results table on the official TALES site; model providers are not independent submitting teams.

dates.zh: 成绩日期取自来源；本站采集日期单独记录。
dates.en: Result dates come from the source; the Atlas retrieval date is recorded separately.

control.zh: 文字观察与文字动作；ALFWorld 仅使用文字模态。
control.en: Text observations and actions; ALFWorld uses only its text modality.

budget.zh: 具体任务、动作预算与模型提示见 TALES 配置；原站表格未逐行列出运行预算。
budget.en: Tasks, action budgets and prompts follow TALES configurations; the source table does not list per-row run budgets.

snapshotLabel.zh: 40 个模型配置 · 五个框架分项

reason.zh: 原站持续加入模型与游戏；围棋榜报告 2026-10-19 更新。该日期仅适用于围棋赛道。
reason.en: The platform adds model and game evaluations; Go reports an update on 2026-10-19, applying only to that track.

dateMissingLabel.zh: 总榜日期未核实；单项见下方
dateMissingLabel.en: Unified date unverified; game dates below

reason.zh: 维护方持续添加模型、游戏与对局证据；GameBench 1 为冻结历史版本。
reason.en: The maintainer adds models, games and match evidence; GameBench 1 is a frozen historical version.

reason.zh: chessbench-v3 的 Best 视图，每个模型保留来源选出的推理配置。
reason.en: The chessbench-v3 Best view, retaining the thinking setup selected by the source for each model.
v0.2 (2026-10-15) follows v0.1 (2026-09-26): independent evaluations updated by release.

reason.zh: Melee 以赛季和分区组织轮赛；社区 Recap 读取官方数据，其同步时间不等于最近对局时间。
reason.en: Melee organizes round-robin play by season and division; the community Recap reads official data, and its sync time is not the latest match time.

reason.zh: 按年度竞赛收录，提交截止日不是成绩更新时间。
reason.en: Indexed as an annual competition; the submission deadline is not a score update date.

reason.zh: 作者发布的研究结果表，未公布成绩更新日期；未确认持续接收新的外部评测。
reason.en: An author-published research results table with no score update date; ongoing external evaluation intake is unconfirmed.
